message.reasoning_content:
We need to list crimes directly supported by facts. The facts describe theft of ancient trees (皂角树) which are protected as ancient trees (三级保护). The act includes illegal acquisition, selling, transporting, and receiving money. Likely crimes: theft (盗窃罪) of public property? Since trees are protected under ancient tree protection ordinance, theft of protected trees may be "非法采伐、毁坏国家重点保护植物罪" (illegal cutting of protected trees) under Chinese Criminal Law Article 338? Actually Article 338: "非法采伐、毁坏国家重点保护的野生植物、林木的，处三年以下有期徒刑或者拘役，并处罚金；情节严重的，处三年以上七年以下有期徒刑，并处罚金。" So crime: illegal cutting/ destruction of protected trees. Also "盗窃罪" for theft of property (trees considered property). Also "非法买卖国家重点保护植物罪" maybe. Chinese law: Article 341: "非法买卖、收购、运输、携带、利用国家重点保护的野生动物、植物的，处三年以下有期徒刑或者拘役，并处罚金；情节严重的，处三年以上七年以下有期徒刑，并处罚金。" So selling protected trees is illegal. Also "组织、领导、参加黑社会性质组织" not relevant. Also "诈骗" not present. Also "职务侵占" not. So likely crimes: 盗窃罪; 破坏国家重点保护植物罪 (非法采伐、毁坏); 非法买卖国家重点保护植物罪. Also maybe "非法占有他人财物" is theft. Also "非法转让古树" maybe "非法买卖古树" under same article.

Thus list: 盗窃罪; 破坏国家重点保护植物罪; 非法买卖国家重点保护植物罪.

Check if any other crimes: "非法采伐" is covered by "破坏国家重点保护植物罪". The facts also include "组织他人实施" maybe "组织盗窃" but not separate. Could be "帮助信息网络犯罪" no.

Thus answer.
